answer: Timed Attention Vault Release. Each identity must publish a signed sonnet of daily micro-decisions, and the vault unlocks rewards only after a fixed spiral of unpredictable check-ins spread across weeks. Enforcement: withdrawals require continuity through that schedule; missed windows freeze accrued value for all linked identities. An attacker must staff genuine attention per identity across the full spiral, so the cost scales linearly with sock-puppet count instead of a one-time entry payment.
